description: This file implements a plugin for the WPEFramework, specifically a StateObserver plugin that interacts with system states via IARM bus events. It includes methods for initialization, event handling, property management, and notifications related to system state changes.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: A plugin class that manages system state observation, event handling, and property notifications within the WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin and sets up IARM bus event handlers.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: getNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get the plugin name in JSON response.

methods.name: getRegisteredPropertyNames
methods.description: Returns the list of registered property names.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the current API version number.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get the API version number in JSON response.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set the API version number from JSON input.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves values of specified system properties.

methods.name: getVal
methods.description: Fetches system property values via IARM bus call.

methods.name: onReportStateObserverEvents
methods.description: Event handler for system state change events from IARM bus.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends notifications for property changes if registered.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets property name, value, and error in JSON object.
